name: Mordecai
bio: Mordecai, a Benjamite descended from Kish, had been carried into exile from Jerusalem with King Jeconiah. Living in Susa, he raised his orphaned cousin Hadassah, also called Esther, as his own daughter. When King Ahasuerus searched his empire for a new queen, Esther was among the young women brought to the palace; Mordecai instructed her not to reveal her Jewish identity, and he kept daily watch outside the harem to learn how she fared. After Esther became queen, Mordecai, now serving at the king's gate, overheard two chamberlains, Bigthan and Teresh, plotting to assassinate the king; he reported it through Esther, the plotters were hanged, and the event was recorded in the royal chronicles (Esther 2:5-23). His pivotal role opposing Haman is told in detail in the chapters ahead.
